findings.description: The /pos/page.tsx file is a server component but does not export metadata. All other dashboard pages export metadata for proper SEO and static generation.
findings.recommendation: Add `export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Point of Sale', description: 'Kelola transaksi penjualan dengan cepat dan mudah' };` to the file.

findings.description: RetailShell navigation points to /kasir for the cashier function, but there's also a /pos page with minimal content. The masuk page links cashier role to /kasir.
findings.recommendation: Confirm whether /pos is redundant and should be removed, or if it serves a different purpose. If redundant, remove the file to avoid confusion.

findings.issue: POS page has minimal placeholder content
findings.description: Unlike other dashboard pages with full UI implementations, /pos/page.tsx only has a PageHeader and one placeholder paragraph. The /kasir page has the full POS interface.
findings.recommendation: Either remove /pos/page.tsx if it's redundant, or implement it with the full POS interface if it's meant to be the primary route.
